**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is planning a trip to Chicago soon.
- [FACT] User has stayed at the Hyatt Regency in downtown Chicago before for a business conference and loved the area.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for good restaurants near the Hyatt Regency.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Gage: Modern American cuisine with a focus on local and seasonal ingredients. (2-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Berghoff: A Chicago institution since 1887, serving classic German-American dishes like sausages and schnitzel. (4-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Harry Caray's Italian Steakhouse: A popular spot for steak, pasta, and Italian favorites. (5-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Purple Pig: A Mediterranean-inspired restaurant with small plates and a lively atmosphere. (6-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Girl & the Goat: Top Chef winner Stephanie Izard's Mediterranean-inspired restaurant with a focus on wood-fired cooking. (8-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Au Cheval: Trendy diner known for their burgers, which are often named one of the best in the city. Be prepared for a wait, though! (10-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Black Dog Gelato: A sweet spot for unique gelato flavors and coffee. (5-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Eataly: A massive Italian market and food hall with various stations serving pasta, pizza, seafood, and more. (12-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Polo Café: A contemporary American bistro with a focus on seasonal ingredients and a great brunch menu. (10-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Connie's Pizza: A Chicago staple for deep-dish pizza, also serving thin-crust and Italian dishes. (12-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User asked for good breakfast spots near the Hyatt Regency.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wildberry Cafe: A popular spot for creative breakfast dishes, sandwiches, and pastries. (5-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Original Pancake House: A breakfast institution with a vast menu featuring pancakes, omelets, waffles, and more. Be prepared for a wait, especially on weekends. (7-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yolk: A modern breakfast and brunch spot with a focus on locally sourced ingredients. (8-minute walk)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lou Mitchell's: A beloved Chicago institution since 1923, serving up classic breakfast dishes, omelets, and pancakes in a cozy atmosphere. (10-minute walk)
